cases.name: Day-only proposal books first common free slot
cases.said: Alex: Let's meet Thursday to finalize the launch checklist.

cases.name: Exact time that is free gets booked
cases.said: Priya: Can we meet tomorrow at 11am to review the onboarding flow?

cases.name: Exact time with a conflict is not booked; alternatives offered
cases.said: Alex: Can we also sync on Tuesday at 2pm about the budget?

cases.name: Part of day respected (Thursday afternoon)
cases.said: Marcus: Let's catch up Thursday afternoon on the vendor contract.

cases.name: Invite including an external guest waits for approval
cases.said: Sam: Let's meet with Dana next Tuesday at 10am to walk through the contract.

cases.name: Self-commitment with deadline becomes a task
cases.said: Priya: I'll send the updated pricing deck to the team by Wednesday.

cases.name: Request + acceptance assigns task to the right person
cases.said: Marcus: Sam, can you draft the press release by Friday? / Sam: Sure, I'll take that.

cases.name: Third-person assignment ("Marcus will ...")
cases.said: Sam: Marcus will handle the vendor contract renewal before Friday.

cases.name: Decision is logged
cases.said: Marcus: Okay, we decided to go with the annual pricing plan for launch.

cases.name: Voice command email to external contact needs approval
cases.said: Sam: Hey Sidekick, email Dana the launch date is November 18th.

cases.name: Pause stops recording until resume
cases.said: Priya: Sidekick, stop recording for a minute. / Marcus: Off the record, I'll fire the vendor by Friday. / Priya: Okay Sidekick, resume.

cases.name: Same proposal repeated is not double-booked
cases.said: Alex: Let's meet Thursday to finalize the launch checklist. / Priya: Yes, let's meet Thursday for the launch checklist.

cases.name: Small talk triggers nothing
cases.said: Sam: How was everyone's weekend? / Priya: Good, I went hiking with my family. / Marcus: I will never get used to these early mornings.

cases.name: Negated proposal ("let's not meet Friday")
cases.said: Alex: Let's not meet Friday, half the team is out.

cases.name: Indirect phrasing ("circle back")
cases.said: Priya: Can we circle back on this Wednesday afternoon?

cases.name: Team-only email request is sent immediately
cases.said: Alex: Sidekick, email Priya and Marcus the notes about the beta numbers.
